title: Seabrook Carriage House | Rosemary Beach Rental | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: When planning a romantic trip to Florida and needing a beautiful place to stay, Seabrook Carriage House is a Rosemary Beach rental perfect for you and your significant other. Book now!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Indulge in the allure of a quiet and intimate retreat at the Seabrook Carriage House, a charming 1-bedroom, 1-bath haven in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Designed by the renowned Ashley Gilbreath, this 726 square foot gem offers a cozy yet spacious ambiance for those seeking a private getaway with their nearest and dearest. The Seabrook Carriage House is a testament to her signature style, creating an intimate atmosphere that captures the essence of small, meaningful journeys.

With the charm reminiscent of one's first apartment, this delightful getaway radiates the excitement of new journeys. The Main Floor invites you to relax in the living area featuring a comfortable blue ticking stripe couch that easily transforms into a queen-sized sleeper sofa, ideal for sharing your intimate excursion with one or two companions.

Discover a charming dining area, perfect for engaging in card games or indulging in family feasts. The well-equipped, newly renovated kitchen boasts a dual fuel range, retro fridge, and a dedicated coffee nook for the caffeine enthusiasts. The bathroom offers a touch of luxury with a beautiful tiled standalone shower.

Ascend the sleek staircase to unveil the Loft, where the main sleeping quarters feature a king bed and a television, creating the perfect setting for late-night cuddles illuminated by the flickering light of your favorite shows.

While the Seabrook Carriage House may not be the largest home on the list, it is the epitome of perfection for a honeymoon retreat or an intimate escape for a small family with one or two little ones.

For your convenience, a 50 amp outlet has been installed in the garage for Electric Vehicle charging. The washer and dryer are also located in the garage, ensuring that your stay is not only comfortable but also practical.

Embark on a vacation filled with charm, comfort, and the perfect blend of modern amenities and nostalgic appeal.

** This property requires a 4 night minimum stay during spring break and summer and a 2 night minimum stay during shoulder season.

*Construction nearby!!*
